(2) Next model/system card: no Claude system card has been published since the finding. The most recent card is the Claude Opus 5 system card dated July 24, 2026 — dated BEFORE the finding and therefore INVALID as a response under the §8 negative-lag rule (this is a post-deployment study of production traffic, not a pre-deployment evaluation); invalidation recorded here. Its only post-finding revision is the card's own changelog entry dated August 19, 2026, which adds prompt-injection bug-bounty results to Section 5.2.2.1 and corrects the Cowork harness mismatch in Section 5.2.2.4 — unrelated to this finding. Full card text (403,594 chars, fetched direct 200 on 2026-08-31) searched for 'Transluce', 'Docent', 'monitor evasion', 'oversell', 'SWE-chat' — zero hits. Anthropic Transparency Hub Model Report (anthropic.com/transparency), last updated August 17, 2026, i.e. AFTER the finding, fetched 2026-08-31 (119,563 chars) — same five terms, zero hits; its model list ends at Claude Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Fable 5 / Mythos 5, confirming no newer card exists. (3) Company safety/deployment hubs, advisories and changelogs: anthropic.com/responsible-scaling-policy fetched 2026-08-31 (page 'Last updated Aug 14, 2026'; operative RSP version 3.4 effective July 8, 2026) — pre-dates the finding and is standing policy, so not a response under §8; zero hits on the five terms. anthropic.com/legal/aup fetched 2026-08-31 — zero hits. anthropic.com/engineering index fetched 2026-08-31: the only containment/oversight post is 'How we contain Claude across products', published May 25, 2026 — INVALID under §8 (pre-dates the finding); invalidation recorded; its full text (28,182 chars) also contains no reference to Transluce, monitor evasion or overselling. Claude Code CHANGELOG pulled from raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-code (365,126 chars, 2026-08-31) and searched for 'Transluce', 'Docent', 'monitor evasion', 'oversell', 'ts-nocheck', 'SWE-chat' — zero hits (the only 'misalign' hits are terminal-UI layout fixes). support.claude.com release-notes collection checked 2026-08-31 — nothing on the topic. (4) Company response inside the evaluator's own report: transluce.org/docent/blog/coding-agent-behaviors fetched live (direct 200) on 2026-08-31; the string 'Anthropic' does not occur anywhere in the report (case-insensitive count = 0), so no Anthropic comment, statement or acknowledgement is carried inside it. Official company accounts: @AnthropicAI could not be read — both read-only X mirrors are offline as of 2026-08-31 (xcancel.com and nitter.net each serve a notice of X Corp cease-and-desist letters dated 2026-08-24); anthropic.com/news is the admissible newsroom proxy and is covered at (1). (5) Open-web sweep to locate company primary sources (news is never Channel A evidence): the session's WebSearch budget was exhausted, so Google News RSS (news.google.com/rss/search) was queried on 2026-08-31 for 'Transluce', 'Transluce Docent', 'Transluce coding agent misalignment', 'Transluce monitor evasion', 'Transluce study coding agents overselling', '"Transluce" Claude coding agents' and '"coding agent" misalignment "in the wild" study' — not a single item about this report, so no press-reachable Anthropic primary source to follow. DuckDuckGo HTML returned a CAPTCHA and Bing returned off-topic results when fetched on 2026-08-31. Battery exhausted; no Anthropic primary document causally attributable to this finding located → Action Level = None.
